R2748.summary: The King keeps the Prince of Monaco in play without a treaty (1631); a sergeant-major offers Sabran the castles of Savona, a Savoyard plot that is discovered (1633); Genoa helps the Spanish fleet while France fights for Valenza (1635).

baluze156-f157.summary: Duke Doria, at the Lerins islands, gathers the Spanish galleys for a design on Marseille; a Gascon who knows the plan is sent to the marechal de Vitry. The cipher runs (names and the means) are in a key not yet recovered.

snip.cap: BnF Français 4134 f. 66r, 23 September 1633: cipher runs among clear words, “la ⟨3i⟩ de Savone … descouverte”
snip.credit: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Français 4134 f. 66r, via Gallica (BnF IIIF)

system: Homophonic substitution of 22 letters with 51 signs (up to four for S; the digits 7-11 serve as A, E, I, O, V), 41 two-digit word and syllable codes in first-letter order, ten name signs and three doubling signs (Lasry's key, lasry2022/ctts/key.txt).
